en.headline: Science Museum food-science show runs through 28 October
en.dek: The museum and the French consulate opened the ground-floor exhibition on 1 October as part of a French science festival, the Hong Kong Economic Journal reported.
body: A food-science exhibition at the Hong Kong Science Museum remains open through the holiday weekend, after opening on 1 October.

The Hong Kong Economic Journal reported that the museum is presenting the show with the Consulate General of France in Hong Kong and Macau. It runs until 28 October in the ground-floor exhibition hall and is part of a French science festival. The display looks at culture, science and innovation in cooking, and at the science behind how food is prepared.
The government news channel also carried the exhibition on Saturday. Admission and daily hours were not set out in those reports.

zh.headline: 科學館「創味盤中餐」展至10月28日
zh.dek: 香港經濟日報報道，科學館與法國駐港澳總領事館合作，地下展覽廳由10月1日起展出，屬法國科學節節目。
body: 香港科學館「創味盤中餐」展覽假期周末繼續開放。香港經濟日報報道，展覽由10月1日開始，至10月28日。
報道指，科學館與法國駐港澳總領事館合作，在地下展覽廳展出，屬法國科學節節目之一，內容涵蓋文化、科學與創新，介紹烹飪背後的科學原理。
政府新聞網周六亦介紹了這項展覽。上述報道未列出門票及每日開放時間。
